Annotation Interface CockroachDBTransactional

@Target({METHOD,TYPE}) @Retention(RUNTIME) @Inherited @Documented @Transactional public @interface CockroachDBTransactional
@Transactional with CockroachDB's retry paradigm for SERIALIZABLE transactions: when the transaction fails with SQLSTATE 40001, the whole method is run again in a fresh transaction, with exponential backoff and jitter.

This is a composed annotation: it is meta-annotated with @Transactional, so Spring's own transaction support runs the transaction, and every @Transactional attribute below means exactly what it does there. The one difference is that isolation() defaults to SERIALIZABLE, CockroachDB's default level.

Plain @Transactional methods get the same retries, with the cockroachdb.retry.* defaults, unless cockroachdb.retry.apply-to-transactional-methods=false. Use this annotation when a method needs different retry settings or a fixed region(), or to keep retrying it when that property is off.

Retries happen only at the outermost transactional call. A method called inside a transaction that is already running runs once; if it hits a 40001, the outermost call retries the whole unit of work.

      String region
